$comment: Runtime surface manifest (LLP 0010#runtime-command-surface; upstream LLP 0175 §8.1a in exact) — the single authority for the ibex command surface, kept next to the clap tree it pins. visibleCommands appear in `ibex --help` and must work standalone. hiddenHarnessCommands are compiled in but hidden from help (`self-test` is a CI harness smoke, not a user test runner; `compat` is the WPT/exact compat harness ported from exact-cli, ENG-23081 — its fixture tree lives in the exact repo). reservedCommands are runtime-namespace names with no implementation yet, and legacyProjectCommands are Exact project commands; both classes must be ABSENT from the clap tree entirely — the pre-clap dispatcher in src/bin/ibex/main.rs owns them and errors with a pointer. Pinned in-process by cli.rs::surface_manifest_matches_clap_tree (ported from exact's stranded packages/exact-cli test, ENG-22429); exact-side behavior guards read their own stale copy until retargeted here.
